meta.title: WP Consent API Demo
meta.author: WordPress Contributors
meta.description: Installs WP Consent API and opens an interactive category and service consent demo.

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$content = '[wp_consent_api_demo]';
$page = get_page_by_path( 'consent-api-demo' );

if ( $page ) {
	$page_id = $page->ID;
	wp_update_post(
		array(
			'ID'           => $page_id,
			'post_title'   => 'WP Consent API Demo',
			'post_content' => $content,
		)
	);
} else {
	$page_id = wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_title'   => 'WP Consent API Demo',
			'post_name'    => 'consent-api-demo',
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_type'    => 'page',
			'post_content' => $content,
		)
	);
}

if ( $page_id && ! is_wp_error( $page_id ) ) {
	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
	update_option( 'page_on_front', $page_id );
	flush_rewrite_rules();
}
